findings.description:
Reentrancy in [EtherStore.withdraw()](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L17-L27):
	External calls:
	- [(sent,None) = msg.sender.call{value: bal}()](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L22)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- [balances[msg.sender] = 0](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L26)
	[EtherStore.balances](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L10) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- [EtherStore.balances](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L10)
	- [EtherStore.deposit()](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L12-L14)
	- [EtherStore.withdraw()](examples/contracts/EtherStore.sol#L17-L27)
findings.recommendation: Review and fix the vulnerability
